name: install_adb_package
description: Install one local APK on the device (`adb install [-r]`), recording the APK's host digest and byte size. A device-mutating tool: `replace_requested` records whether `-r` was selected; `replaced` is null because install success does not establish prior package state. The device's own Success/Failure verdict is preserved with its reason.

serial.description: Device serial exactly as `adb devices` reports it

apk_path.description: Existing local APK file to install

replace.description: Request replacement mode and keep existing app data if present (adb install -r); does not establish whether the app was already installed

__schema0.description: Device serial exactly as `adb devices` reports it

__schema1.description: Existing local APK file to install
